name: Text to Speech (TTS) by Mementor
author: Mementor AS

sections.description:
Text to speech for WordPress — add natural AI voices in seconds.
Bring your posts, pages, and products to life with Text to Speech (TTS) by Mementor.

This powerful accessibility plugin converts your WordPress content into clear, human-sounding audio using advanced AI voices powered by ElevenLabs.

Use it to improve your site’s accessibility for visually impaired visitors, boost on-page engagement, and help meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 and ADA compliance — no code, no configuration required.

Start with 5,000 free audio credits. No API keys. No account setup. No hassle.

See It In Action

🔧 Full feature list, screenshots, and pricing

🎥 Watch the 4-minute plugin demo

Why Choose Mementor’s Text-to-Speech Plugin?

**Fast & Easy Setup**

Just install and go. There’s no need for API keys, developer access, or third-party accounts.

**Natural AI Voices**

Powered by ElevenLabs, your content is read aloud in high-quality, human-like voices that sound authentic—not robotic.

**Accessibility Built-In**

Make your site more inclusive with text-to-speech that helps meet legal and ethical accessibility standards like WCAG 2.1/2.2 and the ADA.

**Works With Any Theme or Builder**

Seamlessly integrates with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Fusion, and all modern WordPress setups. Fully responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Text to Speech for WordPress: Key Features

  • 5 000 FREE trial credits (one-off) – works immediately after install
  • Natural AI voices (ElevenLabs) in male & female tones
  • WCAG 2.1-AA compliance – ARIA labels, keyboard control, high-contrast support
  • 70+ languages & accents – English + Norwegian free; 70 total with PRO
  • Zero-click install – audio player activates on publish
  • Mobile-first audio player – speed control, download, seek
  • Page-builder ready – Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Visual Composer
  • Shortcode & block for custom placement
  • Automatic detection – converts new and existing content
  • Lightweight & cache-friendly – no impact on Core Web Vitals

PRO (US $3.99 / month, billed annually) – unlock full power

  • 60 000 credits / month – 12× more characters than free trial
  • All 70 languages & 600+ voices
  • 44.1 kHz premium quality
  • WooCommerce product audio
  • Voice cloning – use your own ElevenLabs voice ID
  • Bulk generation – select multiple posts/pages and generate audio for all at once
  • Custom pauses – add natural breaks after titles, between paragraphs, and after headings
  • Word replacement – automatically replace words/phrases for better pronunciation
  • Custom intro / outro branding
  • White Labeling – hide settings from clients for complete branding
  • Engagement analytics dashboard
  • Priority live-chat support

Accessibility & Compliance

  • Meets WCAG 2.1 Level AA for audio alternatives
  • Screen-reader & keyboard-navigation compatible
  • High-contrast ready; no flashing elements
  • Helps limit exposure to ADA demand letters

Multilingual Support

Fully compatible with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Weglot, and other i18n plugins.

External services

ElevenLabs API

  • Purpose: Converts your text into high-quality, natural-sounding audio—core to the plugin’s TTS feature.
  • Data sent:
    • Post/page text selected for audio generation
    • Your ElevenLabs API key (if connected)
    • Voice ID & speech settings you choose
  • When sent:
    • Manual “Generate Audio” clicks
    • Automatic generation on publish/update (if enabled)
    • Regeneration after changing voice settings
  • Storage:
    • Audio files saved in /wp-content/uploads/text-to-speech-tts/
    • Files and text also stored in your ElevenLabs account (counts against character quota)
  • Plans & quotas:
    • ElevenLabs free tier: 10 000 characters/month
    • Mementor PRO: 60 000 characters/month—no separate ElevenLabs plan needed
  • Links: Terms • Privacy

Mementor Software Checkout / Licensing (Lemon Squeezy)

  • Purpose: Handles purchase and licensing of the PRO version.
  • Data flow: No data is auto-sent by the plugin. Users are redirected to software.mementor.no (powered by Lemon Squeezy) only when they click “Upgrade / Purchase.” Any checkout data is processed directly by Lemon Squeezy.
  • Links:
    • Mementor Terms of Service
    • Mementor Privacy Policy
    • Lemon Squeezy Buyer Terms
    • Lemon Squeezy Privacy

Privacy

  • No tracking beyond optional engagement analytics
  • Only selected text is sent to ElevenLabs for synthesis
  • API keys are stored encrypted in WP options
  • Full data removal on uninstall

Credits

Natural voice synthesis by ElevenLabs – https://elevenlabs.io

This plugin includes an affiliate link to ElevenLabs. If you choose to purchase through this link, we may earn a small commission, at no extra cost to you. Thank you for supporting our plugin!
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress admin go to Plugins → Add New, search “Text to Speech (TTS) by Mementor.”
  2. Click Install Now → Activate.
  3. Enjoy 5 000 one-off trial credits straight away.
  4. (Optional) Connect an ElevenLabs API key for 10 000 free characters every month, or upgrade to PRO for 60 000.
  5. Adjust player style under Settings → Text to Speech if desired.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No key is needed for the initial 5 000-credit trial.
After you’ve used those, connect your free ElevenLabs account (10 000 credits/month) or upgrade to PRO for higher limits.

Is the plugin WCAG compliant?

Yes. Output audio, controls, ARIA labelling and keyboard support meet WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.

Which languages are free?

English (US, UK, AU, CA) and Norwegian. PRO unlocks the full 70-language catalogue.

Will it work with my theme or page builder?

Absolutely. We test with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Visual Composer and stock Twenty-series themes.

Can I bulk-convert old posts?

Yes – upgrade to PRO and use Tools → Bulk Generate Audio to process back-catalogues in one click.

Does it slow down my site?

The audio player is lazy-loaded and compatible with caching/optimisation plugins. Generation happens off-site.

Can I customise the voice?

Free offers several English & Norwegian voices. PRO adds 600+ voices and personal voice cloning via ElevenLabs.

1.6.8 – 2025-09-16

  • Fixed: Admin notices from other plugins now display correctly on Text to Speech settings pages
  • Fixed: Navigation menu now highlights the active page when using WordPress sidebar menu
  • Improved: Better compatibility with other WordPress plugins
  • Enhanced: Cleaner admin interface without unwanted notice interference

1.6.7 – 2025-09-12

  • Major UI Overhaul: All admin pages have been modernized with a consistent, professional card-based design system.
  • This update brings a fresh, modern look to the Text to Speech plugin while maintaining all existing functionality. The new design improves usability and creates a more professional appearance that matches modern WordPress standards.

1.6.6 – 2025-09-11

  • New: Bulk audio generation – Select multiple posts/pages and generate audio for all at once (PRO feature)
  • New: Custom pause controls – Add natural breaks after titles, between paragraphs, and after headings (PRO feature)
  • New: Word replacement system – Automatically replace words or phrases for better pronunciation (PRO feature)
  • New: Modern Content Settings page – Completely redesigned with an intuitive, grid-based layout
  • Enhanced: Added “Cooking Up Some Fresh Audio…” playful messaging during bulk generation
  • Enhanced: Improved PRO feature visibility
  • Fixed: Double checkmark display in bulk generation results
  • Fixed: Bulk generation notice now properly clears after completion
  • Improved: Better error handling and user feedback throughout the plugin

1.6.5 – 2025-09-09

  • Added: Support for custom word replacements in generated audio
  • Enhancement: Text preprocessing now supports automatic word/phrase substitutions for improved speech clarity
  • New: NIAB text marker is automatically replaced with “–Important Note–” for better audio comprehension

1.6.4 – 2025-09-07

  • Fixed: Content marked with “no-audio” class is now properly excluded from audio generation
  • Fixed: Special characters and spaces are now read correctly in generated audio
  • Fixed: Critical errors that could break site functionality
  • Improved: Better compatibility with Elementor page builder
  • Improved: Content exclusion settings now work reliably with all page builders
  • Improved: More accurate content extraction that respects your exclusion settings
  • Enhanced: Audio regeneration now always uses the latest content and settings
  • Enhanced: Better handling of complex page layouts and nested content
  • Enhanced: More reliable content filtering for cleaner audio output

1.6.3 – 2025-09-07

  • Fixed: Elementor titles still appearing in audio when “Include Title” is enabled
  • Enhanced: Better detection and removal of Elementor heading widgets
  • Improved: Added specific handling for Elementor theme post title widgets
  • Fixed: Title duplication for sites using Elementor page builder

1.6.2 – 2025-09-07

  • Fixed: Duplicate title in generated audio when title is included in post content
  • Improved: Content extraction now excludes title elements when “Include Title” option is enabled
  • Improved: Better handling of Fusion Builder titles to prevent duplication
  • Enhanced: Added automatic title selector exclusion for common WordPress themes

1.6.1 – 2025-09-07

  • Fixed: Critical error on some websites preventing pages from loading
  • Fixed: Player showing on content without audio for users who downgraded from PRO
  • Fixed: Compatibility issues with certain themes and page builders
  • Improved: Better error handling to prevent site crashes

1.6.0 – 2025-09-07

  • NEW: White Labeling System for PRO users – completely rebrand the plugin as your own
  • NEW: Customize plugin name, logo, author details, and website links
  • NEW: Set different names for Free and PRO versions in the plugins list
  • NEW: Control who can see the White Label settings page
  • NEW: Hide Affiliate Program and License menus from clients
  • NEW: Restrict White Label access to specific users by email or username
  • Fixed: PHP Fatal Error when accessing PRO features without PRO plugin installed
  • Fixed: Player showing on pages without audio for users who downgraded from PRO
  • Fixed: “Limited API Key Permissions” warning appearing with valid unrestricted keys
  • Fixed: Inconsistent PRO version detection across the plugin
  • Fixed: PRO voice selection and visual hover effects
  • Fixed: White Label settings not saving properly
  • Fixed: White Label menu not visible to active PRO users
  • Improved: Menu organization – White Label now appears after Affiliate Program
  • Improved: Simplified PRO detection for better reliability
  • Improved: Direct API validation for more accurate permission checking

Earlier versions

Voice-quality upgrades, multilingual expansion, and broad theme compatibility. See plugin repo for full log.
